preconditions.description: The length of the input string N is between 1 and 49, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '47' for c in N)
preconditions.description: All characters in the input string N are either '4' or '7'.

postconditions.description: The result is a positive integer representing the position of the string N in the series of numbers composed of only digits 4 and 7.

postconditions.expression: exists(n for n in range(1, 100000) if str(n) == N)
postconditions.description: There exists at least one number n in the range from 1 to 100000 (or a larger range if necessary) such that the string representation of n is equal to N.
